data.describe()

# Checking for Missing Values
```{python}
data.isna().sum()
```
# Converting the Date Column
```{python}
data["date_local"]=pd.to_datetime(data["date_local"])
data.info()
```
# Plotting the AQI Distribution
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.histplot(data["aqi"], bins=30, kde=True, color="pink")
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
# Counting Records by State
```{python}
data["state_name"].value_counts()
```
# Finding State-wise Percentage Distribution
```{python}
data["state_name"].value_counts(normalize=True)*100
```
# Counting Unique States
```{python}
data["state_name"].nunique()
```
# Calculating Average AQI for Each State
```{python}
data.groupby("state_name")["aqi"].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
```

data["state_name"].describe()
